trial.seed_rule: trial i uses seed base_seed+i; base_seed=20260910

stimulus.type: PoissonInput per GRN, N=1, weight=w_syn*f_poi, refractory of stimulated GRNs set to 0

readout.aggregation_rationale: Post-M1c completeness decision: L10331 primary, R16949 secondary; both recorded.
readout.rate_definition: spikes in [0, duration] / duration, mean over trials; also report std over trials

A_prime_sugar_lb3c.note: Two fresh 120 Hz conditions; neither is in the A-D 420 trials. Not executed at M0.

notes: Paper calibrated w_syn on FlyWire v630; we run v783 only, absolute Hz may differ.
Model baseline firing is 0 Hz by construction (no intrinsic activity); condition D measures it anyway.

male_provenance.model_parameters: Inherited byte-for-value unchanged, including model.source attribution.
male_provenance.scope: Whole CNS; M0 only baseline and sugar200 five-trial benchmarks. M1/M2 require checkpoints.
male_provenance.calibration: Transfer is a model assumption, not male behavioural calibration.

brain_provenance.structural_rationale: Female FlyWire contains no VNC and Shiu parameters were calibrated brain-only. A male brain-only endpoint cut is a structural substrate comparison, not a fitted weight. Hypnagogia reports about80Hz male MN9 at200Hz with brain-only scope and0.581 count scaling; that different design motivates testing scope but does not set our weight or prove equivalence.
brain_provenance.stimulus_rule: Fixed female0.275*250=68.75mV/event in both candidates; no future stimulus-weight variant.
brain_provenance.changes: Brain endpoint substrate, recurrent candidate weight, primary metadata; all other dynamics/seeds/input layout unchanged. Inherited male_provenance describes original M0 and is superseded for these fields.

shape_gate.S1: At least four of five mean MN9 rates > 0 Hz.
shape_gate.S3: Sugar200 whole-network spike max/min < 3; zero minimum fails (undefined or infinite ratio).
shape_gate.reuse: A provides 25/50/100/200; AP_sugar_120 provides 120. No added S runs.

brain_provenance.pass_rule: Historical A-D and S1-S3 must all pass on L10331; R16949 recorded, not deciding.
brain_provenance.scope: 420 A-D +60 A-prime per candidate, 960 total; no other candidate or M2.
brain_provenance.further_variant_rule: Each further variant needs a distinct structural rationale written before running, all gates including S, and reporting regardless of outcome. No w_syn sweep, isolated failed-gate repair, or removal of failed variants.
